# PDF Master Pro

> 32 free, browser-based PDF tools — merge, split, compress, convert, unlock and more. No file size limits, no login, no server upload: every file is processed locally in your browser and never leaves your device.

## Organize
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into one document
- [Split PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/split): Split PDF into separate pages or ranges
- [Extract Pages](https://pdfmaspro.com/extract-pages): Extract specific pages from a PDF
- [Delete Pages](https://pdfmaspro.com/delete-pages): Remove unwanted pages from a PDF
- [Reorder Pages](https://pdfmaspro.com/reorder-pages): Drag and drop to reorder PDF pages
- [Rotate Pages](https://pdfmaspro.com/rotate): Rotate PDF pages 90°, 180° or 270°
- [PDF Bookmarks](https://pdfmaspro.com/pdf-bookmarks): Add clickable bookmarks and table of contents

## Convert
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfmaspro.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to JPG images
- [PDF to Text](https://pdfmaspro.com/pdf-to-text): Extract all text content from a PDF
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF
- [Bank Statement Converter](https://pdfmaspro.com/bank-converter): Convert Indian bank statement PDFs to Excel/CSV (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak)
- [GST Invoice Reader](https://pdfmaspro.com/gst-invoice): Extract GSTIN, invoice number, CGST/SGST amounts from Indian GST invoices
- [Excel to PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel/CSV spreadsheets to PDF
- [PDF to Excel](https://pdfmaspro.com/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables from PDF into Excel or CSV
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/word-to-pdf): Convert .docx and .txt documents to PDF

## Optimize & Security
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/compress): Reduce PDF file size by 30-80%
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/unlock): Remove password protection from a PDF
- [E-Signature](https://pdfmaspro.com/e-signature): Sign a PDF digitally — draw, type or upload signature
- [OCR PDF](https://pdfmaspro.com/ocr-pdf): Extract text from scanned PDFs (English and Hindi)

## Key facts
- All 32 tools run entirely client-side; files are never uploaded to a server
- No file size limits, no account or login required, free with no daily caps
- Bank Statement Converter and GST Invoice Reader are built specifically for Indian financial documents
- Full tool list and live app: https://pdfmaspro.com/
